fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance so responders can identify the property quickly from the road.
• Mark the driveway entrance with posts or reflective delineators on both sides to make it clearly visible at night or in low-visibility conditions.
• Trim trees and shrubs along the driveway so vehicles can travel the full length without obstruction from overhanging branches or encroaching growth.
• Keep the driveway surface clear of parked vehicles, equipment, or debris to allow emergency vehicles to reach the residence without delay.
• Identify a designated turnaround area at or near the main residence so emergency vehicles do not need to back the full length of the driveway to exit.
• Cut back dense vegetation along the sides of the driveway to give responders a clear view of the structures as they approach.
• Install a gate lock box or quick-access mechanism at any gated entry point so responders are not delayed waiting for access.
• Trim vegetation around both detached structures so responders can reach and move around them on foot without obstruction.
• Keep a clear walking path between the main residence and both detached structures for responder movement on foot.
• Identify and mark any gate or gap in the perimeter fencing that allows access to the rear of the property and communicate its location to responding agencies.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim tree branches that extend over or touch any of the structures in the cluster.
• Thin the tree cluster to create open gaps between individual trees.
• Remove or cut tall grass in the area identified near the structures before it dries out seasonally.
• Keep grass mowed short across the open terrain surrounding the structures.
• Trim shrubs and low vegetation growing directly against any structure in the cluster.
• Cut back vegetation growing along both sides of the driveway to keep it passable and visible.
• Remove dead or dry plant material from the irrigated landscape beds adjacent to structures.
• Keep the area under scattered trees clear of dead leaves, fallen branches, and dry grass buildup.
• Move any stored materials, wood piles, or loose debris away from the sides of structures.
• Keep the single access route clear of overhanging branches and encroaching vegetation at all times.
• Mark the driveway entrance clearly so it remains visible to emergency vehicles approaching the property.
